bio: Situated near to the historic towns of Chipping Campden and Broadway, Charingworth Manor is a 14th-century manor house set in its own 50-acre grounds, with views across the Cotswold countryside. Inside there is a historic patchwork of intimate public rooms, furnished with antiques and log fires burning during the colder months. Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea at Charingworth Manor where delicious tea time treats are an essential part of their history. Taken in the stunning lounge you will enjoy a full Afternoon Tea to include sandwiches, cakes, scones with cream and jam as wells as a variety of teas and coffees. Relax and tuck in to your goodies in an elegant and exquisite hotel.
